title: retry_charge
question: what happens when the gateway drops the call
author: claude-code

text: retry_charge asks the gateway to charge an order and tries again when the call is dropped, up to `attempts` times, before it gives up with a ChargeError.

title: One attempt
text: one_try is a single call to the gateway for the order's total. It is a function of its own so the loop below stays short.

title: Try, then give up
text: The loop makes up to `attempts` tries. The first one that does not drop returns its answer; when all of them drop, the error names the order.

title: A dropped call tries again
text: Only a *ConnectionError* counts as a dropped call: it moves on to the next try. Any other error leaves the loop at once.
Invoice.total adds the amounts of the invoice lines and has the tax applied for the invoice's country. It is what the customer is charged.
apply_tax raises an amount by the country's rate and rounds it to cents, so the total on the invoice is the amount that is charged.
